title: Interweaving Marginals into Multivariate Sample Paths: Training-Free Dependence Construction for Probabilistic Time Series Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.25980v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Probabilistic time series foundation models (TSFMs) provide coordinate-wise predictive distributions, but these marginals do not determine a joint distribution over multivariate future trajectories. We study training-free coupling of frozen TSFM marginals into multivariate forecast sample paths. Our primary evaluation fixes the empirical marginal sample multiset at every channel--horizon coordinate across methods, isolating the effect of coupling alone. Historical temporal and channel relations substantially improve their corresponding dependence diagnostics. The same pattern persists when the fixed-marginal constraint is removed and paths are sampled directly, and remains present under native multivariate backbone inference. These results support treating dependence reconstruction as a distinct post-processing problem for probabilistic TSFMs.

translated_title: 将边缘分布交织到多元样本路径中：面向概率时间序列基础模型的无训练依赖性构建
translated_abstract: 概率时间序列基础模型（TSFM）提供逐坐标的预测分布，但这些边缘分布并不能确定多元未来轨迹上的联合分布。我们研究了将冻结的TSFM边缘分布以无需训练的方式耦合为多元预测样本路径。我们的主要评估在所有方法中将每个通道-时间步坐标处的经验边缘样本多重集固定，从而单独分离出耦合本身的效果。历史的时间关系和通道关系显著改善了其对应的依赖性诊断指标。当移除固定边缘约束并直接采样路径时，同样的模式依然存在，并且在原生多元骨干模型推理下该模式也保持存在。这些结果支持将依赖性重建视为概率TSFM的一个独立的后处理问题。
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需训练的方法，将冻结的概率时间序列基础模型的边缘分布耦合为多元预测样本路径，并通过固定边缘样本的对照实验证明，利用历史时间与通道关系进行依赖性重建能显著改善依赖性诊断，支持将依赖性重建作为概率TSFM的独立后处理问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a training-free method to couple frozen probabilistic time series foundation model marginals into multivariate forecast sample paths, demonstrating through fixed-marginal controlled experiments that dependence reconstruction using historical temporal and channel relations substantially improves dependence diagnostics, supporting it as a distinct post-processing problem for probabilistic TSFMs.
